title: “Sound It Out – Spelling is EASY!”
style: reggaeton pop rap, Miami Spanglish hooks, 128 BPM, male rap lead, female harmony ad libs, group chant chorus, 808 sub bass, snap claps, brass stabs, conga shakers, güiro percussion, synth drop chorus, tape saturation, plate room combo, radio vocal compression, late-night neon, jubilant momentum, half-time dembow, syncopated clap grid [Style of music: upbeat Miami Spanglish reggaeton pop rap fusion, 128 BPM, energetic male rapper with smooth female harmonies and group chants, Latin trap beats mixed with pop drops, fun educational “sound it out” vibe, heavy bass, claps, brass hits, tropical percussion, feel-good summer Miami party energy, bilingual flow, catchy hooks, professional studio mix, phonetic beat drops on every chorus]
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey amigo, tú ya sabes… Spelling is EASY, just sound it out!
Say the word aloud – that’s what it’s all about!
No stress, no tricks, you do it every day,
Phonetic magic – now let’s show the way!

[Chorus]
Tú ya sabes – Sound It Out, it’s EASY, you already know!
Say the letters loud, watch the spelling flow!
Like /k/ /a/ /t/ makes CAT, simple as a beat,
Phonetic is your superpower, can’t be beat!
Rap the sounds together, make the rhythm sweet,
Spelling is just music for your tongue and feet!
You already know – no need to fear the page,
Tú ya sabes Spelling – now turn the page!

[Verse 1 – Music & Rap Analogy]
In the studio you rap the beat without a book,
Sound out the lyrics – that’s all it took!
Like “reg-ga-e-ton” breaks into easy parts,
You already spell it when you sing from the heart!
Phonetic flow is like the bass in your chest,
Say it aloud, spell it right – you’re the best!

[Chorus]
Tú ya sabes – Sound It Out, it’s EASY, you already know!

[Verse 2 – Cooking & Mixing Analogy]
En la cocina you mix sounds like ingredients,
/p/ /i/ /z/ /z/ /a/ – pizza, no ingredients missing!
Blend the letters like salsa on the plate,
Say it slow, spell it fast – it’s never too late!
Just like adding spice, phonetic is the key,
You already cook words perfectly!

[Verse 3 – Driving & Street Signs Analogy]
Driving down Miami Beach, see the signs fly by,
Sound them out loud – “S-T-O-P” you don’t even try!
“Highway” is /h/ /i/ /w/ /e/ /i/, easy as the breeze,
You read every billboard without a single squeeze!
Street names, store signs, all around the town,
Phonetic makes it simple – never let it get you down!

[Bridge – Games & Building Analogy – beat drops hard]
Wait… you thought spelling was hard? Nah, it’s Lego blocks!
Snap the sounds together – click, click, it rocks!
Games with your crew, spelling bee but fun,
Say it aloud, win the round – you already won!
Like building a sandcastle on the beach so fine,
Phonetic pieces fit – the castle is all mine!

[Verse 4 – Beach & Everyday Talk Analogy]
On the sand you call your friends with a shout,
“¡Ven acá!” sounds out easy, no doubt!
Every conversation, every name you say,
You already spell it when you speak that way!
Nature does the sounds – waves crash, birds tweet,
Phonetic is the language that makes life sweet!

[Verse 5 – Daily Life Analogy]
From morning text to the menu at the spot,
Sound it out quick – that’s all you got!
No problema with the words on the screen,
Important notes, perfect flow, you know what I mean!
Flexible mind, possible to read anything,
You already know Spelling – let your voice sing!

[Chorus – bigger, full group vocals + claps + crowd cheers]
Tú ya sabes – Sound It Out, it’s EASY, you already know!
Say the letters loud, watch the spelling flow!
Like music, cooking, driving, games, and beach,
Phonetic is your secret – within your reach!
No stress, no fear, just pure celebration,
You know more Spelling than you ever imagined!

[Outro – chant style, big tropical drop + fade]
Tú ya sabes Spelling… it’s EASY, you already know…
Sound it out loud, watch the whole world flow!
Phonetic in the kitchen, phonetic on the street,
Phonetic in the music – can’t be beat!
¡Sonido! ¡Letras! ¡Fácil! ¡Celebración!
You already know Spelling – ¡eso es la verdad!
Tú ya sabes… tú ya sabes… Sound It Out, let’s go!
